findings.finding: The chain-pacing step computes elapsed = now - PASS_STARTED_EPOCH under `set -euo pipefail`, but the plan does not specify behavior when PASS_STARTED_EPOCH is unset/empty. The existing _run_redispatch harness runs the re-dispatch step body in isolation with a fixed env (PATH + MODE only) and the plan requires the disabled-422 benign-no-op test to pass UNCHANGED; an unset variable in arithmetic can abort the step and break both the real skip-branch and that pre-existing test.

AC: 'capped by RECONCILE_CHAIN_PACING_CAP_MINUTES (default 15) and skipped above 30 minutes elapsed; a test asserts both the sleeping and the skipping branch' — the cap-clamp branch is the load-bearing bound that 'pacing can never convert a slow pass into a timeout-minutes: 60 kill' relies on, yet it is unasserted.
findings.finding: The pacing step has three behavioral branches — (1) sleep for elapsed when elapsed < cap, (2) sleep clamped to the cap when cap <= elapsed < 30 min, (3) skip entirely when elapsed >= 30 min. The Testing section exercises branch (1) ('capped value not hit') and branch (3) ('past the 30-minute skip threshold'), but does not exercise branch (2) — the cap actually clamping the sleep. AC line 3 asserts 'capped by RECONCILE_CHAIN_PACING_CAP_MINUTES (default 15)' yet no test verifies the clamp value, so a defect that computed the wrong capped duration (or failed to clamp) would ship green.
findings.location: Testing → 'Edge / failure path'; Acceptance Criteria line 3
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the `_run_redispatch` harness to cover elapsed=~20min (cap=15): assert the stubbed sleep records 900s (the cap), not the elapsed value.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Justify why the pacing cap must be a configurable repo Variable (RECONCILE_CHAIN_PACING_CAP_MINUTES) rather than a literal, given the 30-minute hard skip and timeout-minutes: 60 already bound the sleep; if the extra knob is not needed, collapse to the single 30-min skip guard.
evidence: Plan: 'the sleep is capped by repo Variable RECONCILE_CHAIN_PACING_CAP_MINUTES (default 15), and is skipped outright once elapsed >= 30 min'
reconcile-bridge.yml line 80: 'timeout-minutes: 60' already caps total job time; the 30-min skip alone keeps pass+sleep under that ceiling
grep for RECONCILE_CHAIN_PACING returned no existing call-sites — this is net-new config surface, not reuse of an existing key
Operator directive names only 'double the time between runs' — no tunable cap requested (config-surface-proliferation / YAGNI)
findings.finding: The chain-pacing lever introduces a NEW repo Variable RECONCILE_CHAIN_PACING_CAP_MINUTES (default 15) as a second guard bound on top of an already-hard-coded 30-minute skip threshold and the existing timeout-minutes: 60 job ceiling — three overlapping bounds on one sleep, where the operator directive asked for no configurable knob.
scenarios: A template adopter now inherits a second bridge tuning Variable they must understand and document, alongside RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS
A future edit to the 30-min literal and the 15-min Variable can silently diverge, since both bound the same sleep

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the 'literally doubled at any pass duration' claim with the 15-min cap and 30-min skip (state that exact doubling holds only for elapsed < cap, and that 'elapsed' is whole-job wall-clock, not the ~7-min reconcile-pass figure quoted from docs).
evidence: Plan: 'the re-dispatch step sleeps for the pass's own elapsed duration ... Period becomes two pass durations — literally doubled at any pass duration'
Plan: 'the sleep is capped by ... RECONCILE_CHAIN_PACING_CAP_MINUTES (default 15), and is skipped outright once elapsed >= 30 min'
PASS_STARTED_EPOCH is recorded by 'a new early step' (before checkout/setup/reconcile), so elapsed is whole-job wall-clock
findings.finding: The plan frames the injected sleep as 'the pass's own elapsed duration' yielding 'two pass durations', but elapsed = now - PASS_STARTED_EPOCH measured from an early step spans the whole job (checkout, setup-python, pip install, acli download, reconcile), not the ~7-min reconcile pass the plan quotes from docs. Combined with the 15-min cap, exact 2x doubling only holds for jobs whose measured elapsed is below the cap; between the cap and 30min the multiplier is <2x, and above 30min it is 1x (no sleep).
scenarios: A cold-start job (toolchain install) pushes measured elapsed past 15min -> sleep capped, actual period < 2x
A slow bulk pass pushes elapsed past 30min -> no sleep, period = 1x (undoubled) despite the directive asking to double 'the chained reconciler invocation'
